title: Group-graded Ore extensions and graded simplicity
summary: We study Ore extensions $R[t;σ,δ]$ of rings graded by an arbitrary group $Γ$. The grading of $R$ extends to a grading with $t$ homogeneous of degree $γ$ if and only if $σ$ and $δ$ are compatible with conjugation and translation by $γ$, and this grading is then unique. For nonabelian $Γ$ the degree of $t$ need not centralize the support of $R$; this twist can be removed by a change of variable when $R_γ$ contains a unit, but not in general.
